signature.name: VTask.liftOn
signature.type: {M : Type u_1} -> [CommMonoid M] -> {S : Submonoid M} -> {p : Sort u} -> (x : Localization S) -> (f : M → ↥S → p) -> (H : ∀ {a c : M} {b d : ↥S}, (Localization.r S) (a, b) (c, d) → f a b = f c d) -> p

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: VTask.liftOn is a total recursion principle; it carries no junk-value conventions because it is defined for every element of Localization S given the well-definedness hypothesis H, with an arbitrary target sort p.

facts.statement: ∀ {M : Type*} [CommMonoid M] {S : Submonoid M} (x : Localization S) (k : ℕ), VTask.liftOn x (fun _a _b => k) (fun _h => rfl) = k

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; unvalidated by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ {M : Type*} [CommMonoid M] {S : Submonoid M} {p : Sort*} (x : Localization S) (f g : M → ↥S → p) (Hf : ∀ {a c : M} {b d : ↥S}, Localization.r S (a, b) (c, d) → f a b = f c d) (Hg : ∀ {a c : M} {b d : ↥S}, Localization.r S (a, b) (c, d) → g a b = g c d), (∀ a (b : ↥S), f a b = g a b) → VTask.liftOn x f Hf = VTask.liftOn x g Hg

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; unvalidated by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ (a : ℕ) (b : (⊤ : Submonoid ℕ)) (f : ℕ → (⊤ : Submonoid ℕ) → ℕ) (H : ∀ {a c : ℕ} {b d : (⊤ : Submonoid ℕ)}, Localization.r ⊤ (a, b) (c, d) → f a b = f c d), VTask.liftOn (Localization.mk a b) f H = f a b → VTask.liftOn (Localization.mk a b) f H ≠ f a b + 1
